title_candidates: ChatGPT's new memory is easier to inspect and correct
summary: OpenAI is rolling out a new ChatGPT memory system that synthesizes past context, stays more current, and gives users a summary they can review and correct.

primary_source.title: Dreaming: Better memory for a more helpful ChatGPT
primary_source.author: OpenAI
key_facts: OpenAI is rolling out a new memory system built on a background synthesis process.
The system provides a memory summary users can review and correct.
The rollout starts with Plus and Pro users in the United States.

prerequisites: A ChatGPT account with memory available

steps.instruction: Review and correct the memory summary, then verify the correction in a new chat.

references.title: Dreaming: Better memory for a more helpful ChatGPT
references.author: OpenAI

risk_flags: Rollout availability varies by plan and country.
